THE GREAT SNACK HEIST
 ScriptM8 Stress-Test Script
 
Genre: Teen comedy / light mystery
Setting: Community centre, late afternoon
Characters: Jack (adult) · Emily (adult) · Bella (teenager) · Lily (teenager)
Stress-test focus: 200 dialogue lines, rapid character switching, short/medium/long lines, questions, interruptions,
emotional shifts, repeated speakers and scene breaks.
SCENE 1 — THE MISSING SNACKS
1 — JACK
Okay. Nobody panic.
2 — EMILY
You saying that means I should definitely panic.
3 — BELLA
What's happened?
4 — LILY
Did someone break something?
5 — JACK
Worse.
6 — EMILY
The Wi-Fi?
7 — JACK
The snacks.
8 — BELLA
What about them?
9 — JACK
They're gone.
10 — LILY
All of them?
11 — JACK
Every single packet.
12 — EMILY
That's serious.
13 — BELLA
Extremely serious.
14 — LILY
Who was responsible for putting them away?
15 — JACK
I was.
16 — EMILY
And you lost them?
17 — JACK

I didn't lose them.
18 — BELLA
Then where are they?
19 — JACK
That's the problem.
20 — LILY
You don't know.
21 — JACK
Correct.
22 — EMILY
Excellent management.
23 — JACK
Thank you.
24 — EMILY
That wasn't a compliment.
25 — BELLA
When did you last see the snacks?
26 — JACK
Around four o'clock.
27 — LILY
And what happened after that?
28 — JACK
I put them in the cupboard.
29 — BELLA
Which cupboard?
30 — JACK
The big one.
31 — EMILY
There are three big cupboards.
32 — JACK
The biggest one.
33 — LILY
That really narrows it down.
34 — JACK
Look, I was busy.
35 — BELLA
Doing what?
36 — JACK
Trying to fix the printer.
37 — EMILY
Did you fix it?
38 — JACK
No.

39 — LILY
So you've lost the snacks and broken the printer?
40 — JACK
The printer was already broken.
SCENE 2 — THE INVESTIGATION
41 — EMILY
Right. We're investigating.
42 — JACK
We're doing what?
43 — EMILY
Investigating.
44 — JACK
Why?
45 — EMILY
Because apparently I'm the only adult here capable of solving a mystery.
46 — BELLA
I can solve mysteries.
47 — LILY
You watched one detective programme.
48 — BELLA
It was six seasons.
49 — JACK
That's still television.
50 — BELLA
Exactly. Research.
51 — EMILY
Okay, Detective Bella.
52 — BELLA
Thank you.
53 — EMILY
Where do we start?
54 — BELLA
The scene of the crime.
55 — LILY
The cupboard?
56 — BELLA
Obviously.
57 — JACK
Nothing was forced open.
58 — EMILY
Any fingerprints?
59 — JACK

Probably.
60 — LILY
Did you check?
61 — JACK
No.
62 — BELLA
Then how do you know?
63 — JACK
Because I'm not a detective.
64 — EMILY
We've established that.
65 — LILY
Look!
66 — JACK
What?
67 — LILY
A crisp packet.
68 — BELLA
A clue!
69 — EMILY
Or rubbish.
70 — BELLA
Don't ruin this.
71 — JACK
Where did you find it?
72 — LILY
Under the chair.
73 — EMILY
What flavour?
74 — LILY
Salt and vinegar.
75 — BELLA
Interesting.
76 — JACK
Why?
77 — BELLA
Because I hate salt and vinegar.
78 — EMILY
That's your evidence?
79 — BELLA
It's a strong lead.
80 — LILY
No, it isn't.

SCENE 3 — SUSPECT NUMBER ONE
81 — BELLA
Jack.
82 — JACK
Yes?
83 — BELLA
Where were you at four fifteen?
84 — JACK
Still fixing the printer.
85 — EMILY
Can anyone confirm that?
86 — JACK
The printer.
87 — LILY
The printer can't talk.
88 — JACK
Exactly.
89 — BELLA
Convenient.
90 — JACK
Are you accusing me?
91 — BELLA
I'm asking questions.
92 — EMILY
She's accusing you.
93 — JACK
Thank you, Emily.
94 — EMILY
You're welcome.
95 — LILY
Wait.
96 — JACK
What now?
97 — LILY
Jack had the cupboard key.
98 — BELLA
Aha!
99 — JACK
Everyone calm down.
100 — EMILY
That's twice you've said that.
101 — JACK
Because nobody is calm.

102 — BELLA
Where's the key now?
103 — JACK
In my pocket.
104 — LILY
Then you could have taken the snacks.
105 — JACK
I could have.
106 — EMILY
But did you?
107 — JACK
No.
108 — BELLA
How do we know?
109 — JACK
Because I don't eat crisps.
110 — LILY
You ate three packets yesterday.
111 — JACK
Those were different circumstances.
112 — EMILY
How?
113 — JACK
It was Tuesday.
114 — BELLA
That's not an answer.
115 — JACK
It is to me.
116 — LILY
Suspicious.
117 — JACK
I'm surrounded by traitors.
118 — EMILY
You're surrounded by teenagers.
119 — BELLA
Same thing.
120 — LILY
Definitely.
SCENE 4 — SUSPECT NUMBER TWO
121 — EMILY
Right. New theory.
122 — JACK

Please don't.
123 — EMILY
Bella did it.
124 — BELLA
Excuse me?
125 — LILY
Interesting.
126 — BELLA
Why am I suddenly the suspect?
127 — EMILY
Because you're enjoying this too much.
128 — BELLA
That's not evidence.
129 — JACK
It is pretty suspicious.
130 — BELLA
You're supposed to be on my side!
131 — JACK
I'm on the side of justice.
132 — LILY
Very dramatic.
133 — BELLA
Fine. Ask me anything.
134 — EMILY
Where were you at four fifteen?
135 — BELLA
Outside.
136 — JACK
Doing what?
137 — BELLA
Talking to Lily.
138 — LILY
True.
139 — EMILY
For how long?
140 — LILY
About twenty minutes.
141 — EMILY
And then?
142 — BELLA
We came inside.
143 — JACK
Did you go near the cupboard?

144 — BELLA
No.
145 — LILY
Actually...
146 — BELLA
Lily.
147 — LILY
You did.
148 — BELLA
I walked past it.
149 — LILY
You opened it.
150 — BELLA
For one second.
151 — JACK
Why?
152 — BELLA
I wanted a drink.
153 — EMILY
Did you see the snacks?
154 — BELLA
Yes.
155 — JACK
Were they there?
156 — BELLA
Yes.
157 — LILY
Then Bella didn't take them.
158 — EMILY
Unless she came back later.
159 — BELLA
I didn't!
160 — JACK
Okay. New problem.
SCENE 5 — THE TRUTH
161 — LILY
What?
162 — JACK
I think I know where they are.
163 — EMILY
You do?
164 — BELLA

Where?
165 — JACK
The cupboard.
166 — LILY
We checked the cupboard.
167 — JACK
You checked the big cupboard.
168 — EMILY
Yes.
169 — JACK
The snacks aren't in the big cupboard.
170 — BELLA
Then where are they?
171 — JACK
The small cupboard.
172 — LILY
You said the big cupboard!
173 — JACK
I know.
174 — EMILY
You've spent twenty minutes investigating something you put in the wrong cupboard?
175 — JACK
Apparently.
176 — BELLA
That's incredible.
177 — LILY
Wait.
178 — JACK
What?
179 — LILY
If the snacks are in the small cupboard...
180 — EMILY
Yes?
181 — LILY
Who ate the biscuits?
182 — BELLA
What biscuits?
183 — LILY
The chocolate ones.
184 — BELLA
I didn't.
185 — EMILY
Neither did I.

186 — JACK
Definitely wasn't me.
187 — LILY
Then why is there chocolate on Jack's shirt?
188 — BELLA
OH!
189 — EMILY
Jack!
190 — JACK
That is not chocolate.
191 — LILY
What is it?
192 — JACK
Mud.
193 — BELLA
It's indoors.
194 — JACK
Fine.
195 — EMILY
You ate the biscuits.
196 — JACK
Maybe.
197 — LILY
How many?
198 — JACK
Two.
199 — BELLA
There were twelve.
200 — JACK
...Okay, maybe twelve.
 END
